3.1.2 Deltamethrin technical and triazophos technical concentrate employed in the manufacture of the material, shall conform to IS 12005 and IS 14936 respectively. 3.2 Physical 3.2.1 Description The material shall be brown coloured, homogeneous and stable liquid. It may contain negligible suspended particulate matter. It shall readily form an emulsion on dilution with water suitable for spray. 3.2.2 Cold Test No turbidity or separation of solid or oily matter shall occur when the material is subjected to the cold test at 10"C as prescribed in 13.1 of 1S 6940. 3.2.3 Flash Point (Abel) When determined by the method prescribed in IS 1448 [P : 20], the flash point of the material shall be above 24.5�C. 3.2.4 Emulsion Stability

1S 15157:2002 3.3.2 4ciclit?'l[!lk~~linity When tes[eci by the method prescribed in 13.5 of IS 6940, the acidity (as HZSOJ or alkalinity (as NaOH) of the material shall be not more than 0.5 and ().2 percent by mass respectively. 4 PACKING The material shall be packed in aluminum containers (1S 9445. IS 9503) and/or pet containers conforming to IS 13123 and containers shall be further packed into corrugated fibre board boxes. Bulk packs of 10 to 25 I capacity can be packed into epoxy coated mild steel containers with leak proof and pilfer proof closure system. In addition, the material shall comply with general requirements as given in IS 8190 (Part 2). 5 MARKING S. I `fhe container shall be securely closed and shall bear legibly and indelibly the following information in acfdition (o any other information as required under the /n.sc'(ticides Act, 1968 and Rules: a) b) c) d) e) 1) g) h) Name of the material; Name and address of the manufacturer; Batch number; Date of manufacture; Date ofexpiry; Net Imass of contents; Nominal value : Deltamethrin content, percent ()~7/m), and triazophos content (rrdnr); and A cautionary notice worded as in the /t7sccticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder; and Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977. 5.2 BIS Certification Marking

me product may also be marked with the Standard Mark. 5.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards. 6 SAMPLING When freshly manufactured material in bulk quantity and/or the retail pack of the formulated product is/are offered for inspection, representative sample of the material shall be drawn and tested as prescribed in 1S 10627, and if tested within 90 days of its date of manufacture, the criteria for conformity shall be the contents in percent (m/m), shall not be less than the declared nominal value. The upper limit for conformity shall be the same as those given in 3.3.1. When the material is offered for inspection after 90 days of its manufacture, sampling shall be done as prescribed in 1S 10627, however, the criteria for conformity of the material, when tested, shall be the limits of tolerances, as applicable over the declared nom inal value and given under 3.3.1. 7 TESTS 7.1 Tests shall be carried out by the methods referred in 3.2.1 to 3.2.4 and 3.3.1 and 3.3.2. 7.2 Quality of Reagents

Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and distilled water (see IS 1070) shall be employed in tests.
